mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P.RESV_ID, P.PAY_METHOD, P.PAY_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.RESV_ID ORDER BY P.PAY_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, P.PAYMENT_ID DESC) AS RN FROM TB_PAYMENT P WHERE P.PAY_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' ) PAY ON PAY.RESV_ID = R.RESV_ID AND PAY.RN = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.EMAIL AS memberEmail, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) AS stayId, S.NAME AS stayName, SR.NAME AS roomName, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT AS cancelFeeAmt, R.REFUND_AMT AS refundAmt, R.CANCEL_AT AS cancelAt, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, P.PET_NAME AS petName, PAY.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, PAY.PAY_DATE AS payDate FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID
WHERE R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'
AND R.STATUS_CD IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED')
AND R.STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}
AND ( UPPER(R.RESV_NO) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(M.MEMBER_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(S.NAME, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY R.REG_DATE DESC, R.RESV_ID DESC

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "PENDING", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "CONFIRMED", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'CHECKIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "CHECKIN", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'CHECKOUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "CHECKOUT", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "DONE", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS_CD IN ('CANCEL','REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "CANCEL", COUNT(*) AS "ALL" FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'

SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.EMAIL AS memberEmail, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) AS stayId, S.NAME AS stayName, SR.NAME AS roomName, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.CANCEL_FEE_AMT AS cancelFeeAmt, R.REFUND_AMT AS refundAmt, R.CANCEL_AT AS cancelAt, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, P.PET_NAME AS petName, PAY.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, PAY.PAY_DATE AS payDate FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID
WHERE R.RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'
